text:
jin: quick status — compact milestone checkin. planning to merge KV hotpath TTL heuristic tomorrow, but wanted to call out a couple deps and ownership clarifications.

maria: noted. which PR? any perf numbers from the microbench?

jin: PR is #4892. microbench local runs show ~7-9% p99 latency drop for 1k token windows when prefetch hits are >60%. numbers vary with batch size.

alex: pinging @maria for rollout gating on Dedicated. we need to confirm fallback policy before canary.

maria: I can own the dedicated fallback. timeline: put canary behind flag `compact_kv_v2` and run 1% traffic for 48h. if no regressions, ramp to 10% then full.

jin: sounds good. ops-bot: can you schedule canary and give a short playbook?

ops-bot: scheduled canary -> canary-20240209-42. playbook link: https://internal/redwood/playbooks/kv-canary. automated rollback threshold: p99 increase >3% OR error rate +0.5%.

sophie: small ask — kernel team needs an exported metric for KV-prefetch hit ratio per-model variant. currently we only have host-level aggregate. will add a todo to the PR, but want owners clear.

jin: kernel team (alex) owns metric export. alex — can you confirm ETA?

alex: yes, I'll add the metric by EOD. will expose `kv_prefetch_hit_ratio{model,variant}`.

maria: for canary, we'll also collect cost delta and token throughput. please include these tags.

jin: adding quick checklist:
- merge PR #4892 (jin)
- add metric kv_prefetch_hit_ratio (alex)
- flag + canary schedule (ops-bot / maria)
- confirm fallback policy and SLO runbook (maria)
- add perf/regression test in perf-lab (sophie)

maria: FYI — I found a small regression when batch_size=1 on GPU A100 pinned kernels. not blocking, but will watch during canary.

jin: thanks. if it shows up at scale we'll flip `compact_kv_v2` off and roll to previous model variant.

alex: quick note on deps — runtime-compiler change in #4920 might affect kernel selection; I'll coordinate with runtime infra to sequence merges.

jin: plan: block merging #4892 until #4920 has a green in staging, unless kernel fallback covers mismatch. everyone ok with that?

maria: +1 from me.

sophie: +1, I'll wire perf tests to run against the staging branch combo.

ops-bot: deploy succeeded for staging combo (4892+4920) at 2024-02-09T15:10Z. Canary ready: canary-20240209-42. metrics streaming to dashboard: /dashboards/kv/compact-milestone.

jin: great — I'll start the 1% ramp at 15:30Z. will post a short summary in 12h or earlier if issues. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all, appreciate the quick sync.
